# EGO POWER+ LM2206SP — 1100 Series 22" Aluminum Deck Self-Propelled Mower

**Category:** Lawn Mower (cordless walk-behind, self-propelled)

**MSRP:** ~$1,299 (kit; retailer-listed — EGO's site shows no price / "Coming Soon")

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Series | 1100 Series (EGO's top-tier walk-behind line) |
| Model / SKU | LM2206SP (kit with battery + charger); LM2200SP (tool only) |
| Power system | 56V ARC Lithium — compatible with all EGO 56V batteries |
| Included battery | 10.0Ah ARC Lithium (BA5600T) |
| Included charger | POWER+ 700W Turbo Charger (CH7000) |
| Runtime | Up to 70 min on a single charge with the 10.0Ah battery |
| Charge time | ~60 min (10.0Ah battery on the 700W Turbo Charger) |
| Motor | High-efficiency brushless |
| Cutting torque | Up to 11.1 ft-lbs |
| Blade speed | Up to 3,350 RPM; selectable ECO / Normal / Turbo modes via LED controls |
| Deck | 22" cast aluminum, lifetime warranty with registration |
| Cutting system | Select Cut multi-blade — upper blade + interchangeable lower blades (High-Performance Blade and High-Lift Bagging Blade) |
| Cutting height | 1" – 4", 8 positions, dual levers (front and rear) |
| Self-propel | Touch Drive palm-pressure engagement; variable speed 0.9 – 3.1 MPH via fingertip dial |
| Grass collection | 2.5-bushel easy-access bag; mulch, bag, or side discharge |
| Lighting | Bright LED headlights (on/off via LED controls) |
| Weather rating | IPX4 |
| Storage | Handle folds for compact vertical storage |
| Warranty | Lifetime deck (with registration); 5-year limited tool; 3-year limited battery (5-year with registration) |
| Accessories | High-Performance Blade Set AB2200D; High-Lift Bagging Blade Set AB2201D; Walk-Behind Mower Cover CM002; Mower Phone Holder APH1000 |

## Notable Features

- Cast aluminum deck backed by a lifetime warranty — the differentiator over the 1000 Series' Super Composite deck
- Highest torque (11.1 ft-lbs) and blade speed (3,350 RPM) of EGO's Select Cut walk-behinds
- Select Cut interchangeable lower blades let you tune for mulching vs. bagging
- Three blade-speed modes trade runtime against cut power
- Touch Drive self-propel engages with palm pressure rather than a bail lever
- IPX4 weather resistance and LED headlights for dawn/dusk mowing
- Battery is shared across the entire EGO 56V platform
